Daily Devotional

June 21

7 For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness. (1 Thessalonians 4:7 KJV)

God does not call His children to live in uncleanness, or sin, but to live a separated holy life (1 Peter 1:16). Does that mean that a Christian doesn’t ever sin? No, as we all come short of the Glory of God, and sin (Romans 3:23). God does not expect us to be able to live a holy life and that is why He gave us the Holy Spirit when we are born again. Our new Spirit is created in holiness and righteousness (Ephesians 4:24), and then sealed (Ephesians 1:13) so that when we sin we do not corrupt our new born again Spirits. God is a spirit (John 4:24) and sees us in the spirit, so we appear holy to God even when we sin. Thank you Jesus.

If you ever get a true revelation as to how much God loves you, you will want to live a holy life out of love for Him. We love Him because He first loved us, and God is love (1 John 4:8). God knows that the humans He created are not perfect, and fall into sin occasionally, but because of His great love for us, He has given us a new Holy Spirit so that we appear Holy to Him, so that He can fellowship with us (John 17:3). The Word says, we were created by Him and for Him, for His good pleasure (Revelation 4:11), and He loves us so much He became a man and died for us. Wow, we can never love Him enough to repay all He has done for us, so we need to thank Him every day in every way. Thank you Lord!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
